title: #328 Marks
prompt: Marks encourage students to learn. To what extent do you agree with this statement?

promptSegments.text: To what extent do you agree with this statement?

hardVocabulary.enGloss: A key word in this prompt.
A key word in this prompt.
A key word in this prompt.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Marks provide students with a clear goal for their study.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Marks provide students with a clear goal for their study.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Marks help students to focus on certain subjects.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Marks help students to focus on certain subjects.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Marks do not always help students to learn because students might focus only on getting high grades, causing them to study only for the test and forget the real subject matter.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Marks do not always help students to learn because students might focus only on getting high grades, causing them to study only for the test and forget the real subject matter.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Furthermore, marks do not show a student's true understanding, as students can do well on a test by guessing answers or copying work, even if their knowledge is weak.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Furthermore, marks do not show a student's true understanding, as students can do well on a test by guessing answers or copying work, even if their knowledge is weak.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Marks give students clear feedback on their academic performance, showing them their strengths and weaknesses, which helps them focus their study time effectively.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Marks give students clear feedback on their academic performance, showing them their strengths and weaknesses, which helps them focus their study time effectively.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Marks also help students to maintain discipline and effort, as students see a direct link between their hard work and the resulting grade.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Marks also help students to maintain discipline and effort, as students see a direct link between their hard work and the resulting grade.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Marks can create pressure, causing students to focus only on passing tests rather than gaining real knowledge about the subject matter.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Marks can create pressure, causing students to focus only on passing tests rather than gaining real knowledge about the subject matter.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Marks do not reflect a student's complete ability because performance can be affected by external factors like stress or illness.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Marks do not reflect a student's complete ability because performance can be affected by external factors like stress or illness.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.

promptTraps.en: Do not explain the statement without making your own position clear.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ giải thích nhận định mà quên nêu rõ quan điểm cá nhân.

modelPlan.focus: evaluate the role of marks in encouraging student learning, considering both their motivational and potential drawbacks.
keyArguments: Marks can provide motivation and clear goals for students, fostering a drive to learn and achieve better results.

However, over-reliance on marks may lead to negative outcomes such as increased stress, narrowed focus on grades rather than understanding, and potential discouragement in the face of poor performance.
